notes: Reviewed alternatives for inferred buying intentions, which are displayed conditionally. Products may cross food families when they serve the same meal or use. Each rule has a nutrient-supported reason, bilingual use guidance and preparation limitations. Price does not determine suitability. All nutrition associations use generic reference foods, not verified product labels. Priority expansion covers snacks, sweetened drinks, instant noodles, pastries, fried meals and condiments. Specific nutrient comparisons are not overall health classifications. See priority-review.md for exclusions.

rules.title: Condensed / evaporated milk -> low-fat liquid milk

intention.en: adding milk to tea or coffee
intention.ms: menambah susu ke dalam teh atau kopi

usage_note.en: Use as the milk component. It will be less sweet or rich; it is not a direct replacement for condensed milk in baking.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan sebagai komponen susu. Rasanya kurang manis atau pekat; bukan pengganti terus susu pekat dalam penaikkan.

rules.title: Full-cream liquid milk -> low-fat liquid milk

intention.en: a milk drink or milk with breakfast
intention.ms: minuman susu atau susu untuk sarapan

usage_note.en: Use as drinking milk or with cereal. Generic milk values may differ from this brand.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan sebagai minuman susu atau bersama bijirin. Nilai susu generik mungkin berbeza daripada jenama ini.

usage_note.en: Use for the same toast or sandwich; texture and flavour will differ.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan untuk roti bakar atau sandwic yang sama; tekstur dan rasa berbeza.

rules.title: Palm / blended oil / ghee -> corn oil

usage_note.en: Use where liquid cooking oil suits the recipe. It will not reproduce the flavour or texture of ghee.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan apabila minyak masak cecair sesuai untuk resipi. Rasa atau teksturnya tidak sama dengan minyak sapi.

rules.title: Red meat -> chicken prepared as skinless breast

intention.en: the main protein in a cooked meal
intention.ms: protein utama dalam hidangan yang dimasak

usage_note.en: The catalogue item is a whole chicken. This comparison applies only to its skinless breast meat; use that cut and adjust cooking time.
usage_note.ms: Item katalog ialah ayam seekor. Perbandingan ini hanya untuk daging dada tanpa kulit; gunakan bahagian itu dan sesuaikan masa memasak.

rules.title: Dried / salted seafood -> fresh Indian mackerel

intention.en: a protein side dish with rice

usage_note.en: Cook fresh fish as the side dish. It does not replace dried seafood used as a seasoning; added salt or sauce changes sodium.
usage_note.ms: Masak ikan segar sebagai lauk. Ia tidak menggantikan makanan laut kering sebagai perasa; garam atau sos tambahan mengubah natrium.

intention.en: an egg side dish with rice

usage_note.en: Boil or cook the fresh egg. It will not reproduce salted yolk flavour for sauces or baking.
usage_note.ms: Rebus atau masak telur segar. Rasanya tidak sama dengan kuning telur masin untuk sos atau penaikkan.

intention.en: the main protein in a cooked meal
intention.ms: protein utama dalam hidangan yang dimasak

usage_note.en: Cook fish instead of the meat course; adjust the recipe and cooking time. This is a different meal option, not an identical ingredient.
usage_note.ms: Masak ikan sebagai ganti lauk daging; sesuaikan resipi dan masa memasak. Ini pilihan hidangan berbeza, bukan bahan yang sama.

rules.title: Dried / salted seafood -> fresh hen egg

intention.en: a protein side dish with rice

usage_note.en: Choose a cooked egg as a different side dish. It does not supply dried seafood seasoning; added salt or sauce changes sodium.
usage_note.ms: Pilih telur yang dimasak sebagai lauk lain. Ia tidak memberikan perasa makanan laut kering; garam atau sos tambahan mengubah natrium.

intention.en: a protein side dish with rice

usage_note.en: Choose cooked fresh fish as a different side dish. It is not a replacement for salted egg sauces; added salt or sauce changes sodium.
usage_note.ms: Pilih ikan segar yang dimasak sebagai lauk lain. Ia bukan pengganti sos telur masin; garam atau sos tambahan mengubah natrium.

rules.title: Full-cream milk powder -> low-fat milk powder

usage_note.en: Follow the pack dilution instructions. The comparison is for dry reference powders, not prepared drinks; low-fat filled powder is not identical to skim milk powder.
usage_note.ms: Ikut arahan pencairan pada pek. Perbandingan ialah untuk serbuk rujukan kering, bukan minuman siap; serbuk susu isian rendah lemak tidak sama dengan serbuk susu skim.

usage_note.en: Choose fresh fruit as the snack. An apple offers crunch, but neither fruit recreates a salty crisp flavour. Values represent generic snack types; flavours and portions differ.
usage_note.ms: Pilih buah segar sebagai snek. Epal memberikan tekstur rangup, tetapi buah tidak memberikan rasa kerepek masin. Nilai mewakili jenis snek generik; perisa dan saiz hidangan berbeza.

intention.en: a snack or sweet bite between meals
intention.ms: snek atau kudapan manis antara waktu makan

usage_note.en: Choose fruit for a snack or sweet bite. It changes the flavour and texture and does not replace biscuits or chocolate as a recipe ingredient. Reference foods and regional labels may differ from the pack.
usage_note.ms: Pilih buah sebagai snek atau kudapan manis. Rasa dan tekstur berbeza; ia bukan pengganti biskut atau coklat sebagai bahan resipi. Makanan rujukan dan label serantau mungkin berbeza daripada pek.

intention.en: a drink for thirst or with a meal
intention.ms: minuman untuk menghilangkan dahaga atau bersama hidangan

usage_note.en: Choose plain water without syrup or sugar. This changes the flavour and does not replace an energy drink for sports fuelling or a soya drink for its protein. Generic drink values may differ from the brand.
usage_note.ms: Pilih air kosong tanpa sirap atau gula. Rasanya berbeza dan tidak menggantikan minuman tenaga untuk bekalan tenaga sukan atau minuman soya untuk proteinnya. Nilai minuman generik mungkin berbeza mengikut jenama.

intention.en: a drink for thirst or with a meal
intention.ms: minuman untuk menghilangkan dahaga atau bersama hidangan

usage_note.en: Choose plain water without syrup or sugar. The reference is regular orange soda; sugar-free variants are outside this mapping. Total sugar is unavailable in this record, so the reason uses energy.
usage_note.ms: Pilih air kosong tanpa sirap atau gula. Rujukan ialah soda oren biasa; varian tanpa gula tidak termasuk dalam pemetaan ini. Jumlah gula tiada dalam rekod ini, maka alasan menggunakan tenaga.

rules.title: Energy drinks -> tea brewed without sugar

usage_note.en: Brew the tea bags in water without sugar, syrup or milk. The nutrition comparison is for brewed black tea, not dry tea leaves. Caffeine strength and effects are not compared.
usage_note.ms: Bancuh uncang teh dalam air tanpa gula, sirap atau susu. Perbandingan pemakanan ialah untuk teh hitam yang dibancuh, bukan daun teh kering. Kekuatan dan kesan kafein tidak dibandingkan.

rules.title: Sweetened milk drinks -> plain low-fat milk

intention.en: a milk drink with breakfast or a snack
intention.ms: minuman susu bersama sarapan atau snek

usage_note.en: Choose plain low-fat liquid milk. It changes sweetness and flavour and does not reproduce cultured-drink or probiotic properties. Check the pack; lactose-free or other dietary requirements are not inferred.
usage_note.ms: Pilih susu cecair rendah lemak tanpa perisa. Kemanisan dan rasa berubah; ia tidak mengekalkan sifat minuman kultur atau probiotik. Semak pek; keperluan diet seperti bebas laktosa tidak diandaikan.

intention.en: a quick hot meal at home
intention.ms: hidangan panas yang cepat disediakan di rumah

usage_note.en: Prepare plain oats with water as porridge, with suitable savoury toppings if desired. This comparison uses dry ingredients; dilution and toppings are extra. The generic noodle entry does not establish the seasoning sachet composition.
usage_note.ms: Sediakan oat kosong dengan air sebagai bubur, dengan bahan tambahan berperisa yang sesuai jika mahu. Perbandingan menggunakan bahan kering; pencairan dan bahan tambahan tidak termasuk. Entri mi generik tidak menetapkan komposisi paket perasa.

rules.title: Kuih / sweet buns / candy -> fresh fruit

usage_note.en: Choose fresh fruit for a sweet snack. It changes flavour, texture and serving size and does not reproduce a kuih, filled bun or candy. Reference recipes and regional product labels may differ; compare the portion you actually plan to eat.
usage_note.ms: Pilih buah segar sebagai snek manis. Rasa, tekstur dan saiz hidangan berbeza dan tidak sama dengan kuih, pau berinti atau gula-gula. Resipi rujukan dan label produk serantau mungkin berbeza; bandingkan saiz hidangan yang anda ingin makan.

rules.title: Fried savoury snacks -> steamed chicken bun

usage_note.en: Choose a steamed chicken bun as a different savoury snack. The filling changes and contains chicken; it does not preserve a vegetarian vadai recipe. Recipes and portions vary.
usage_note.ms: Pilih pau ayam kukus sebagai snek berperisa yang berbeza. Intinya berubah dan mengandungi ayam; ia tidak mengekalkan resipi vadai vegetarian. Resipi dan saiz hidangan berbeza.

rules.title: Fried rice / noodles / murtabak -> noodle soup

usage_note.en: Choose noodle soup as a different main meal. Generic recipe averages are compared; toppings, oil, broth and portion size vary. A lower-fat reference does not guarantee a low-sodium meal.
usage_note.ms: Pilih mi sup sebagai hidangan utama yang berbeza. Purata resipi generik dibandingkan; bahan tambahan, minyak, kuah dan saiz hidangan berbeza. Rujukan rendah lemak tidak menjamin hidangan rendah natrium.

usage_note.en: Choose a boiled egg as a different protein side dish. It changes the protein source and flavour; compare actual portions and accompaniments rather than treating one egg as a whole chicken serving.
usage_note.ms: Pilih telur rebus sebagai lauk berprotein yang berbeza. Sumber protein dan rasa berubah; bandingkan saiz hidangan dan lauk tambahan, bukan menganggap sebiji telur sama dengan satu hidangan ayam.

usage_note.en: Choose a boiled egg as a different side dish. It does not provide the same fish taste or nutrient profile. Reference values compare cooked foods; actual portions and sauces vary.
usage_note.ms: Pilih telur rebus sebagai lauk yang berbeza. Rasa ikan dan profil nutrien tidak sama. Nilai rujukan membandingkan makanan yang dimasak; saiz hidangan dan sos berbeza.

usage_note.en: Choose wholemeal bread for toast. It changes the texture and flavour; butter, jam, kaya and other toppings are not included in the comparison.
usage_note.ms: Pilih roti mil penuh untuk roti bakar. Tekstur dan rasanya berbeza; mentega, jem, kaya dan bahan tambahan lain tidak termasuk dalam perbandingan.

intention.en: adding flavour to a savoury dish

usage_note.en: Use a small squeeze of fresh lime for tang instead of relying on salty sauce. It does not reproduce soy or oyster umami, sweetness, colour or sauce consistency; this is not a one-for-one recipe substitution.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan sedikit perahan limau nipis untuk rasa masam dan kurangkan pergantungan pada sos masin. Ia tidak menghasilkan umami soya atau tiram, kemanisan, warna atau kepekatan sos; bukan pengganti resipi satu dengan satu.

usage_note.en: Mash ripe banana for a naturally sweet toast topping. It changes flavour and texture and needs fresh preparation. Fruit still contains natural sugars; no lower-sugar claim is made because fruit sugar data is unavailable.
usage_note.ms: Lenyek pisang masak untuk sapuan roti bakar yang manis secara semula jadi. Rasa dan tekstur berubah dan perlu disediakan segar. Buah masih mengandungi gula semula jadi; tiada dakwaan gula lebih rendah kerana data gula buah tidak tersedia.

usage_note.en: Mash or slice a plain boiled egg as a different sandwich filling. It does not recreate a creamy mayonnaise dressing; added mayonnaise or sauces are not included.
usage_note.ms: Lenyek atau hiris telur rebus kosong sebagai inti sandwic yang berbeza. Ia tidak sama dengan sos mayonis berkrim; mayonis atau sos tambahan tidak termasuk.

usage_note.en: Choose plain water rather than preparing a sweetened cordial. The original reference is undiluted concentrate, not a finished drink. The table is not a sugar reduction estimate for your diluted serving.
usage_note.ms: Pilih air kosong daripada menyediakan kordial manis. Rujukan asal ialah pati tanpa pencairan, bukan minuman siap. Jadual bukan anggaran pengurangan gula untuk hidangan yang dicairkan.

usage_note.en: Choose plain water rather than preparing rose syrup. The original reference is undiluted syrup, not a finished drink. Dilution changes values; the table is not an estimate for a prepared glass.
usage_note.ms: Pilih air kosong daripada menyediakan sirap ros. Rujukan asal ialah sirap tanpa pencairan, bukan minuman siap. Pencairan mengubah nilai; jadual bukan anggaran untuk segelas minuman siap.

rules.title: Salted butter -> corn oil for cooking

usage_note.en: Use corn oil where liquid cooking oil fits the recipe. It does not reproduce butter flavour, a solid spread or baking structure; adjust quantities.
usage_note.ms: Gunakan minyak jagung apabila minyak masak cecair sesuai untuk resipi. Ia tidak memberikan rasa mentega, sapuan pepejal atau struktur penaikkan; sesuaikan kuantiti.

rules.title: Coconut milk -> low-fat dairy milk for a lighter creamy dish

intention.en: adding a creamy element to a curry or soup
intention.ms: menambah unsur berkrim pada kari atau sup

usage_note.en: Consider plain low-fat dairy milk for a lighter, thinner version and adapt the recipe. It will not reproduce coconut flavour or richness and introduces dairy; it is not a direct recipe replacement.
usage_note.ms: Pertimbangkan susu tenusu rendah lemak tanpa perisa untuk versi lebih ringan dan cair serta sesuaikan resipi. Ia tidak menghasilkan rasa kelapa atau kepekatan yang sama dan mengandungi tenusu; bukan pengganti terus dalam resipi.

usage_note.en: Choose plain peanuts dry-roasted without salt or sugar. If supplied raw, prepare them that way; this reference does not describe salted or coated nuts. Peanuts can be higher in fat and energy than the original snack, so compare actual portions.
usage_note.ms: Pilih kacang tanah yang dipanggang kering tanpa garam atau gula. Jika dibekalkan mentah, sediakan dengan cara itu; rujukan ini bukan untuk kacang masin atau bersalut. Kacang tanah boleh lebih tinggi lemak dan tenaga daripada snek asal, maka bandingkan saiz hidangan sebenar.

rules.title: Biscuits / confectionery / snack foods -> plain peanuts

usage_note.en: Choose plain peanuts dry-roasted without salt or sugar. If supplied raw, prepare them that way; this reference does not describe salted or coated nuts. Peanuts can be higher in fat and energy than the original snack, so compare actual portions.
usage_note.ms: Pilih kacang tanah yang dipanggang kering tanpa garam atau gula. Jika dibekalkan mentah, sediakan dengan cara itu; rujukan ini bukan untuk kacang masin atau bersalut. Kacang tanah boleh lebih tinggi lemak dan tenaga daripada snek asal, maka bandingkan saiz hidangan sebenar.

selection_rule.basis: reviewed buying intention and practical use, allowing different food families
selection_rule.eligibility: a catalogue item with traceable nutrition evidence for the stated use and a supported nutrient improvement

selection_rule.approved_per_rule: reviewed catalogue choices, not a price-based quota
selection_rule.fallback: no suggestion when use fit or nutrition evidence is unsupported
